title: Fix Print Paragraph Chip Alignment
summary: Fixed muted window chip and row window body fill overshoot in print/tex/semio-window.sty by replacing colorbox fills with explicit rule-based paint, adding width-constrained minipage row bodies with hairline frame, and fixing expl3 body bridge (csname, no nested group_begin). Paragraph verify chips align cleanly; cover row fields improved. Compile hang is from competing tectonic watch processes—kill stray tectonic before rebuild.
